H3 (mechanism, from exploratory E0008 pattern of head 2.1: zero self-attention, BOS always attended, later queries attend more to earlier keys): head 2.1 at every position i attends uniformly to BOS plus every position j whose symbol outranks symbol i (order ze>za>vi>gu>tu), or equals it and sits earlier (j<i). So attention-to-BOS = 1/(1+count), and count = 0 only at the FIRST occurrence of the max symbol. mlp2 turns this into a 'I am the winner' flag; head 3.1 at the last position attends to the flagged position and copies its symbol to the output. mlp0/mlp1 prepare the per-position comparison key.
